text: Distributing governance across all participants prevents any single entity from dominating decision making, and because model or training changes then require consensus, the resulting decisions reflect collective rather than individual interest.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: By distributing governance across all participants, the proposed web3 community governance system ensures that no single entity can dominate the decision-making process. This structure promotes the alignment of incentives since changes to the model or the training process require consensus

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: governance systems where change requires consensus among distributed participants
